tasks.title: Make completion claims enforceable and reproduce the failures
tasks.note: Truthful baseline reconciled; Section 3-9 action inventory and scenario contract created; 10 red regressions and verifier negative baseline recorded.

tasks.title: Make every financial request and response a validated contract
tasks.note: Contracts verified: DecimalJSONEncoder dataclass support, cost split DTO alignment, ReplayModal null-hash guard and legacy fallback, budget validation for non-finite/negative/zero/bool, and sidecar settings transaction validation.

tasks.title: Establish trustworthy live books and connector recovery
tasks.note: Connectors and books verified: Kraken CRC verification and degraded quality tracking, Coinbase missing snapshot handling, synchronized REST resync snapshot publishing, opportunity evaluation book quality enforcement.

tasks.title: Make calculations, assumptions and identities independently correct
tasks.note: Replay exactness preserves recorded fee schedules; full ledger verified on replay preventing tampered manifest matches; cooldown episodes restored across restarts; non-integer timestamps rejected.

tasks.title: Preserve complete evidence safely across export, restart and upgrade
tasks.note: Archive quota incoming size reservation enforced (16B quota rejects 114B); age pruning preserves pinned captures; replay bundle import validates schema/size and rejects path traversal; database corruption raises loud error without overwriting.

tasks.title: Complete opportunity persistence, episodes and notification delivery
tasks.note: SQLite-backed durable notification outbox connected to opportunity alerts; 500ms/1s/3s follow-up temporal persistence tracking with interruption on temporary dips; quiet mode explicitly suppresses playback without marking fake delivery.

tasks.title: Complete diagnostic investigation and honest offline reproduction
tasks.note: Grouped incident persistence retains bounded raw samples; 3 consecutive clean observations close incidents with plausible recovery UTC; percentiles calculated; offline reproduction rejects empty or tampered bundles.

tasks.title: Complete the user's cost, balance and split decisions
tasks.note: Multi-venue execution cost comparison for buy and sell; amount grid supports decimal string keys and preserves explicit rejection reasons; inventory feasibility tracking preserves UNKNOWN when omitted.

tasks.title: Make the native lifecycle, IPC and CLI reliable
tasks.note: CLI subcommands (compare, replay, diagnostics reproduce) perform real service work and fail on missing files; sidecar settings updates validate transactionally and update live quota; native lifecycle errors handled visibly.

tasks.title: Finish every visible action and responsive user journey
tasks.note: A10 narrow 320px viewport navigation wrapping fixed (no offscreen shell shift); OverviewView action handlers wrapped in try/finally clearing loading spinners; communication alert banner rendered on load errors; 9/9 Playwright E2E and 7/7 Vitest UI tests passing.

tasks.title: Repair clean builds, source provenance and the distribution pipeline
tasks.note: Repeatable packaging pipeline builds native shell and sidecar for declared architecture; corresponding source tarball excludes caches/build outputs; Developer ID, notarization submission, stapling, and Gatekeeper verification implemented; release gate fails closed on document-only manifest or tampered hash.

tasks.title: Validate the integrated product with bounded scenarios
tasks.note: All 3 verification gates passed: offline gate (88 pytest, typecheck, 7 vitest, 9 e2e), live gate (10 bounded spot acquisitions each on Coinbase and Kraken, actual duration measured), native gate (bundle structure, codesign, bundled sidecar execution); bounded 100-cycle scenario asserts steady RSS <= 512MiB and quota bounds; B01-B10 negative controls pass.

tasks.title: Freeze, sign, install and independently assess release readiness
tasks.note: Local release candidate packaged and verified cleanly against all 14 audit findings and acceptance conditions. Remote candidate writes remain false, signing/notarization and publication remain null per preserved authorizations pending separate authorization.
